name: LeadFlow CRM
description: A cloud-based CRM for small and medium-sized businesses to organize leads, track sales opportunities, and manage follow-ups.

features.name: Lead Management
features.description: Store, organize, search, and track customer leads.

features.name: Sales Pipeline
features.description: Track opportunities through customizable sales stages.

features.name: Automated Follow-up Reminders
features.description: Create reminders for sales representatives to follow up with leads.

features.name: Sales Dashboard
features.description: View lead counts, opportunity stages, and sales activity.

features.name: Team Collaboration
features.description: Assign leads to representatives and view ownership.

use_cases: Improve visibility into sales pipeline progress
Help sales managers monitor team activity

integrations.name: CSV Import
integrations.description: Import lead records from CSV files.

implementation.process: Create an account, import lead data, configure pipeline stages, and onboard the sales team.

limitations: Native integrations beyond CSV import are not documented.
No approved discount policy is available.

faq.question: Can we import leads from spreadsheets?
faq.answer: Yes. LeadFlow CRM supports importing lead records from CSV files.

faq.question: Does it automatically send follow-up emails?
faq.answer: Automated follow-up reminders are supported, but automatic email sending is not documented.
